steps: Start a new game.
Complete the opening sequence to officially begin the expedition.
Attack an enemy repeatedly to fill their Break gauge.
Once the gauge is full, the enemy will enter a Broken state.

achievements.name: Overcharge
achievements.description: With Gustave, use a fully charged Overcharge that Breaks an enemy.

steps: Use Gustave in combat and hold the Overcharge attack.
Fully charge it and release it on an enemy near their Break threshold.
Progress the main story past the opening.
Travel to the Spring Meadows region.
Find a Paint Cage in the overworld (glowing objects).
Attack it to break it open and collect the reward.
Continue the main story beyond Spring Meadows.
Arrive at the Flying Waters region.
Collect weapon upgrade materials from enemies and exploration.
Visit the upgrade station and enhance any weapon once.
Collect Lumina from exploration or battles.
Spend a Lumina point on character upgrades.

achievements.name: Curious
achievements.description: Witness an optional scene at camp.

steps: At any camp rest, look for optional interaction prompts with party members.
Watch the scene to unlock the achievement.
warnings: Some camp scenes are only available at specific story points.

steps: Progress the story past Flying Waters.
Arrive at the Ancient Sanctuary.
Continue the main story.
Arrive at Gestral Village.
Progress the story past Gestral Village.
Reach the Esquie's Nest location.
Find and engage a legendary enemy in the overworld.
Defeat them in combat.

achievements.name: Stone Wave Cliffs
achievements.description: Reach the Stone Wave Cliffs area.

steps: Progress through the main story.
Arrive at Stone Wave Cliffs.
Continue the main story.
Arrive at the Forgotten Battlefield.
Progress the main story through the mid-game.
Reach the Expedition 33 milestone event.
Continue the story.
Arrive at Monoco's Station.
Complete an entire combat encounter without taking damage.
Use perfect dodges and blocks to avoid all attacks.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Easier on early-game enemies. The timing system is similar to action-command RPGs.

steps: Progress the story to the late-game.
Arrive at Old Lumière.
Earn XP from combat encounters and quest completion.
Reach character level 33.

achievements.name: First Axon
achievements.description: Complete the First Axon story event.

steps: Progress the main story.
Complete the First Axon encounter.

achievements.name: Second Axon
achievements.description: Complete the Second Axon story event.

steps: Continue past the First Axon.
Complete the Second Axon encounter.

achievements.name: Professional
achievements.description: Defeat a boss without taking any damage.

steps: Learn a boss's attack patterns thoroughly.
Defeat the boss using perfect dodges and blocks without getting hit.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The first boss (Spring Meadows) is easiest for this. Master the timing-based dodge system.

steps: Find a Monolith structure in the overworld.
Interact with it to trigger the event.

achievements.name: Perfect Flow
achievements.description: Achieve a Perfect Flow in combat.

steps: Chain multiple perfect actions in a row during combat.
Trigger the Perfect Flow state.
Progress the story to the Paintress encounter.
Complete the associated story event.

achievements.name: Back to Lumière
achievements.description: Return to Lumière in the story.

steps: Progress through the late-game story.
Return to the starting city of Lumière.
In Lumière, find the Mime NPC who initiates a fight.
Defeat the Mime in combat.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Mime is a hidden optional boss. Look for a performer in the streets of Lumière.

steps: Build up the Synergy gauge by performing consecutive perfect actions.
Trigger the Synergy ability when the gauge is full.
Progress through all story chapters.
Defeat the final boss and watch the ending.
Invest Lumina points into a single stat.
Reach the maximum value for that stat on one character.
Progress the story to unlock all three vehicle types.
Ride the plane, train, and submarine at least once each.
Continue earning XP from combat and quests.
Reach character level 66.
Progress the main story.
Recruit Sciel to your party when the opportunity arises.
Continue the story.
Recruit Sprong to your party.
Progress to the Esquie's Nest area.
Recruit Esquie to your party.
Continue through the story.
Recruit Lune to your party.
Progress the main story.
Recruit Maelle to your party.
Reach Monoco's Station in the story.
Recruit Monoco to your party.
Unlock and experiment with the Chroma combat system.
Reach proficiency with the Chroma mechanics.
Learn the Wheel-based combat system.
Successfully use the Wheel mechanic in a key encounter.
Progress through the late-game story.
Trigger the À On story event.
Collect enough upgrade materials from endgame content.
Fully upgrade any single weapon to its maximum level.
During a Carreau attack, hit the perfect timing window.
Land a flawless Carreau in combat.
Progress to the late-game story.
Recruit Clea to your party.

achievements.name: Noir et Blanc
achievements.description: Experience the Noir et Blanc event.

steps: Progress through the endgame story.
Witness the Noir et Blanc story event.
Unlock the Endless challenge mode after completing the story.
Survive and complete the Endless gauntlet.
Make specific story choices that lead to the peaceful resolution.
Complete the final sequence to achieve this ending.
warnings: Missable — requires specific dialogue and quest choices throughout the game. Multiple playthroughs may be needed.

steps: Explore every area thoroughly to find lost Gestral NPCs.
Interact with each lost Gestral to rescue them.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: There are Gestrals hidden in every major area. Check behind waterfalls and in dead-end paths.

steps: Find Gestral Game challenges in settlements.
Complete every minigame challenge.
Search for hidden feet collectible items across all areas.
Collect the complete set.
During a specific story encounter, choose to aid the opposing faction.
Complete their request to unlock this achievement.
warnings: Missable — only available during specific story moments. The choice cannot be undone.

steps: Grind XP from endgame encounters and optional bosses.
Reach the maximum character level of 99.

achievements.name: Follow The Trail
achievements.description: Find all of the journals from prior expeditions.

steps: Search every area for journal collectibles left by previous expeditions.
Collect all journals — some are in hidden areas.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Journals are the main lore collectible. Use a guide for the ones in missable areas.

steps: Search the world for 33 hidden music records.
Some are rewards from quests, others are hidden in exploration areas.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The 33 records match the expedition number. Some are in easily-missed side paths.
